header.title: Hello, I'm
header.objectiveText: to bring modern, user-friendly, inclusive, and more environmentally conscious websites to life

about.title: About
about.text: After working 10 years in the occupational health sector, I felt the need to learn new things and express my creativity. Becoming a web developer quickly became an obvious choice. I first trained independently for a year, then started a certified program with OpenClassrooms in 2024. This portfolio is the final step of that program — and I hope the first step toward new professional adventures!

card1.title: Creating a real estate rental web application
card1.technos: React . React-router . Vite . Sass . CSS Animations

objectives.title: 🎯 Project objectives
objectives.item: Develop a real estate rental web application using React. Create a fluid and responsive interface from Figma mockups and implement a dynamic routing system to explore rentals.

skills.title: 🧠 Skills developed
items: Mastery of React (reusable components, props, state) and React Router
Sass integration for clean and organized styles
CSS animations to improve UX
Error and invalid route handling

results.title: 📈 Results and impact
items: Functional application deployed on Vercel
Responsive interface faithful to Figma mockups
Interactive image gallery with infinite navigation
Animated collapsible sections for details
Smooth navigation without page reload

improvements.title: 🛠️ Improvement perspectives
items: Connection to a real backend API
Addition of features (filters, search, favorites)
Performance optimization (lazy loading, code splitting)
Unit and integration tests
User authentication system

card2.title: SEO optimization of a photographer's website

objectives.title: 🎯 Project objectives
objectives.item: Optimize the SEO, performance and accessibility of a photographer's portfolio website.

skills.title: 🧠 Skills developed
items: Technical SEO optimization (metadata, Schema.org structured data)
Web performance improvement (image, script, CSS optimization)
Implementation of WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards
Semantic HTML and code quality
Use of audit tools (Lighthouse, Wave, Color Contrast Analyser)
Technical documentation writing

results.title: 📈 Results and impact
items: 93% reduction in image weight (29.4 MB → 2.07 MB)
Significant improvement in Lighthouse scores (Performance, SEO, Accessibility)
Resolution of all major accessibility errors detected by Wave
Complete implementation of social metadata (Open Graph, Twitter Cards)
Noticeable improvement in loading speed and user experience

improvements.title: 🛠️ Improvement perspectives
items: Creation of a Google Business profile for local SEO
Development of local backlinks and directory listings
Addition of regular content (photography blog)
Implementation of a dynamic gallery management system

Complete WCAG 2.1 site accessibility

Administrator login page with token authentication
Media upload modal with preview and validation

improvements.title: 🛠️ Improvement perspectives

Modular and maintainable CSS architecture
